policies.duration: earliest accepted terminal event_time minus earliest accepted session.start event_time; completed sessions only
policies.trace: terminal sessions with at least one accepted llm.turn and contiguous accepted sequence_number values beginning at 1
policies.late: event_time lag > 10s; accepted only through a 60s event-time watermark
policies.missing_tokens: null counts remain null; excluded from cost calculations
policies.rejected_denominator: all source records from activity, flows, audit, and SIEM
